title:
The Six-Stage Productive Formation Architecture 
A Civilisational Synthesis for Lifespan Formation and Distributed Certification

detail.title:
The Six-Stage Productive Formation Architecture 
A Civilisational Synthesis for Lifespan Formation and Distributed Certification
detail.abstract:
This paper develops a Six-Stage Productive Formation Architecture™-a lifespan model of education organised across six developmental stages from age five to sixty-five. The architecture extends the productive legitimacy framework developed in prior work from the postgraduate professional formation domain to the full human lifespan, drawing on civilisationally comparative analysis of formation traditions from European, Islamic, Confucian, Judaic, Indic, and Japanese contexts, and engaging the foundational comparative education scholarship on each tradition. 
The architecture rests on five convergent intellectual lineages: Aristotelian virtue ethics, Polanyian epistemology and the tacit dimension, the great books humanist tradition, the deliberate practice research programme in cognitive science, and civic republicanism. The paper opens with an explicit defence of its comparative method-functional comparison of formation traditions across the shared problem of lifespan capability development-and presents a cross-traditional convergence table demonstrating that seven structural formation principles appear across all six civilisational traditions examined. Both the successes and the documented failures of each tradition are engaged. 
The architecture is operationalised through a distributed certification system administered by Inovia [X], an independent non-profit certifying body structurally separated from operating institutions. Three levels of partner engagement-certified, recognised, and aligned-accommodate institutional development trajectories. Comparative positioning is developed against the French grandes écoles and the American elite research universities. The equity argument is the architecture's centrepiece commitment: demanding formation standards as non-negotiable while pursuing access expansion through formation density, with falsifiable longitudinal commitments to class-disaggregated graduate outcomes. The paper also engages the lifelong learning and adult education tradition, specifying what the Six-Stage PFA™ adds to that existing literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个六阶段生产性形成架构™，将职业教育的合法性框架从研究生阶段扩展至整个人类生命周期（5-65岁），基于六大文明传统（欧洲、伊斯兰、儒家、犹太、印度、日本）的比较分析，融合亚里士多德美德伦理、波兰尼认识论等五条知识脉络，并通过分布式认证体系运营，以公平为核心承诺。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个覆盖全生命周期（5-65岁）的、跨文明比较的、兼具卓越标准与公平扩张的生产性形成架构？
AI.motivation: 现有教育模型多局限于特定阶段或单一文明传统，缺乏一个从全生命周期视角、整合跨文明形成传统、同时兼顾高培养标准与广泛可及性的系统性架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五条知识脉络：亚里士多德美德伦理学、波兰尼认识论（隐性维度）、经典人文主义传统、刻意练习研究纲领、公民共和主义。同时基于跨文明比较的七项结构形成原则。
AI.method: 跨文明比较分析：对欧洲、伊斯兰、儒家、犹太、印度、日本六大文明的形成传统进行功能性比较，呈现跨传统趋同表，并同时检视各传统的成功与失败案例。
AI.findings: 六大文明传统中存在七项共同的结构性形成原则；提出了六阶段生产性形成架构作为全生命周期教育模型；设计了三级合作机构体系（认证型、认可型、对齐型）以适配不同机构发展轨迹。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生产性合法性框架从研究生专业形成领域扩展至全生命周期；通过功能性比较方法揭示跨文明的七项共同形成原则；整合五条知识脉络形成统一的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出六阶段可操作的全生命周期教育模型；设计分布式认证体系（由独立非营利机构Inovia[X]运营）；建立可证伪的纵向追踪承诺（按阶层分层的毕业生成果数据）；提供公平扩张的具体路径（通过形成密度而非降低标准）。

title: The AIAS Presence Measurement Protocol v1.4: Recognition × Recall Decomposition and Multi-Component AI Availability

detail.title: The AIAS Presence Measurement Protocol v1.4: Recognition × Recall Decomposition and Multi-Component AI Availability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by Samsung Electronics America in a corporate brand governance role. The AIAS research program is conducted outside the scope of employment, on personal time, with no Samsung resources or data. Samsung has no review, approval, or veto rights over AIAS publications. The author has no financial or material interest in any of the brands referenced in this program.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. No human subjects. Measurement is on publicly accessible APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) and pre-specified LLM prompts.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: This paper specifies version 1.4 of the AIAS Presence Measurement Protocol, the canonical methodological framework for measuring AI Availability across LLM-mediated retrieval contexts. v1.4 supersedes v1.2 (SSRN 6761698) and v1.3 (SSRN 6797679), introducing a foundational construct revision: AI Availability is specified as a multi-component construct with Recognition and Recall as the two principal components, rather than a single unidimensional Presence measure. The Recognition component is operationalized via Phase A C_P anchoring (substrate-disambiguation classification across a six-LLM reference panel). The Recall component is operationalized via Phase B LLM-substrate mentionability (unprompted category-conditioned retrieval across the same reference panel under three category queries, producing 18 measurement cells per brand). The empirical anchor for the multi-component construct claim is the v0.17 Premium Kitchenware program: the Iwachu canonical case demonstrates a structurally robust dissociation between Phase A C_P PASS at 6/6 anchoring and Phase B EXCLUDED_E1a at 0/18 mention rate — full Recognition without any Recall. The paper formalizes two reference weightings for the Presence composite: Balanced (w_R = 0.5, w_C = 0.5) and Recall-leaning (w_R = 0.3, w_C = 0.7) as primary. It documents the locked classifier configuration (claude-opus-4-7 with model-default sampling), the locked six-slot reference panel, the locked category query set, the mechanical alias generation rules, and the four-regime taxonomy carryforward from v1.2. The protocol's tier vocabulary (PASS / PASS_E5 / EXCLUDED_E1a) is documented with empirical thresholds. The paper is the canonical methodology citation for all subsequent AIAS program reports (v0.17 onward).

AI.tldr: 本文正式发布了AIAS在场测量协议v1.4，将AI可用性重构为识别（Recognition）与回忆（Recall）双组分构念，并通过Iwachu案例证明两者可完全分离，建立了新的测量方法论标准。
AI.research_question: 如何在大语言模型中介的检索情境中，系统性地测量和量化AI可用性（AI Availability）？
AI.motivation: 此前版本将AI可用性视为单维度的"在场"构念，但实证发现品牌可能被LLM识别却无法被主动回忆，需要更精细的测量框架来捕捉这一关键差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI可用性双组分模型：识别（Recognition）与回忆（Recall）作为两个主成分；基于四制度分类学的测量体系；参考面板加权方案（平衡权重与回忆偏向权重）。
AI.method: 第一阶段（A阶段）：通过六LLM参考面板进行基质消歧分类锚定（C_P锚定）；第二阶段（B阶段）：在同一面板下进行无提示类别条件检索（三种类别查询×六个LLM=18个测量单元/品牌）。
AI.findings: Iwachu经典案例证明了识别与回忆的结构性分离：A阶段6/6完全通过（C_P PASS），但B阶段0/18零提及率（EXCLUDED_E1a），即完全的识别但无任何回忆。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI可用性从单维在场构念修正为识别-回忆双组分构念，为AI时代的品牌资产测量提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后续AIAS项目报告（v0.17起）提供了标准化的方法论引用文档，包括锁定的分类器配置、参考面板、查询集、别名生成规则和阈值设定。

title: Shared Intelligence and Misaligned Firm Entry
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

detail.title: Shared Intelligence and Misaligned Firm Entry
detail.abstract: Firm entry decisions are increasingly mediated by shared intelligence platforms. These platforms can sharpen private forecasts by reducing idiosyncratic noise, but they also route many firms' decisions through a common processing layer that may introduce correlated errors unrelated to fundamentals. We develop a Bayesian entry game in which firms choose between proprietary research and a shared platform, and characterize an equilibrium with heterogeneous adoption. Adoption is excessive under two externalities: synchronized aggregate entry, borne by lenders, landlords, and municipalities, and correlated evaluation, borne by locations screened through the same forecasting system. The result does not depend on whether entry decisions are strategic complements or substitutes, because the framework separates shared processing errors from strategic interaction and informative common signals. A multi-vendor extension shows that vendor diversity reduces the wedge only when platforms are structurally independent. A case study of retail site-selection analytics suggests that nominal vendor competition delivers limited effective diversification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了共享智能平台对企业进入决策的影响，构建了一个贝叶斯进入博弈模型，发现过度采用共享平台会导致两种外部性：同步化的大规模进入和相关性评估错误，从而产生社会效率损失。即使平台之间存在名义竞争，有效分散化也有限。
AI.research_question: 共享智能平台如何影响企业的进入决策？平台采用是否过度？会产生何种外部性？
AI.motivation: 现实中有越来越多的企业依赖共享智能平台（如选址分析平台）进行决策，但这些平台可能引入相关性错误，导致企业决策的同步化和系统性偏差，进而影响劳动力、房地产和公共财政等部门。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯进入博弈模型；分离共享处理错误与战略互动和信息性共同信号的分析框架。
AI.method: 理论建模（贝叶斯博弈均衡分析），辅以零售选址分析平台的案例研究。
AI.findings: 1. 存在过度采用平台的均衡，导致两种外部性：同步化进入（损害贷款人、房东和市政部门）和相关性评估错误（损害被相同预测系统筛选的区域）。2. 该结果不依赖于战略互补或替代关系。3. 多供应商扩展表明，只有当平台结构独立时，供应商多样性才能减少效率损失；零售选址分析案例显示名义竞争带来的有效分散化有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 将共享智能平台的信息处理误差引入企业进入决策理论，区分了共享处理误差与战略互动和共同信息信号的影响，发现了新的外部性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和平台用户注意共享智能平台可能导致的系统性风险和社会效率损失；指出简单的多平台竞争可能不足以解决问题，需要结构性独立性。

title: Verifiable Invoice Commitment: An EVM-Native Standard for Committing Fiscal Metadata to On-Chain Payments

detail.title: Verifiable Invoice Commitment: An EVM-Native Standard for Committing Fiscal Metadata to On-Chain Payments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal conflicts of interest. The author contributes to the x402 open-source reference implementation, which is discussed in the paper as one of several emerging payment rails with which VIC composes; no compensation or sponsorship is associated with this contribution.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a technical paper proposing an Ethereum standard; no human or animal subjects were involved, and no personal data was collected or analyzed. The hypothetical company identifiers used in the TypeScript demonstration (e.g., CUIT 30-12345678-9) are placeholder values for illustrative purposes only.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research. The work was conducted by the author as independent research.

detail.abstract:
On-chain stablecoin payments have reached commercial scale, yet the accounting layer that traditionally accompanies a payment (the invoice, with its fiscal identifiers, tax breakdown, line items, and jurisdictional metadata) has no canonical representation in EVM ecosystems. Reconciliation between a transaction hash and the invoice it satisfies remains a private off-chain concern, fragmenting audit trails and preventing independent verification by tax authorities, auditors, and counterparties. 
This paper introduces Verifiable Invoice Commitment (VIC), a standard that binds structured invoice metadata to on-chain payments via three components: (i) a canonical EIP-712 typed-data schema covering fiscal identity, tax breakdown, foreign-exchange context, line items, and jurisdictional extensions; (ii) a singleton registrar contract deterministically deployable across EVM chains via CREATE2, with arbitrary-nonce replay protection and dual off-chain or encrypted-on-chain payload modes; and (iii) a companion ERC-7730 clear-signing descriptor for hardware-wallet verification. 
VIC composes with existing token contracts without modification, with account abstraction (ERC-4337), with permissioned-transfer hooks (ERC-7943), and with emerging agentic payment rails (MPP, x402). Privacy is preserved by default. We position VIC against prior ERC proposals, international frameworks, and academic constructions; to the best of the author's literature review, no existing standard or production system covers the composition VIC defines, and the related-work survey welcomes correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可验证发票承诺（VIC）标准，将结构化发票元数据与链上支付绑定，通过EIP-712类型数据模式、CREATE2确定性部署的注册合约及ERC-7730硬件钱包描述组件，在保持隐私的同时实现支付与发票的可审计关联。
AI.research_question: 如何为EVM生态系统中的链上稳定币支付建立一个规范的、可验证的会计层（发票）标准，使交易哈希与发票信息能够公开绑定并接受独立审计？
AI.motivation: 链上稳定币支付已达商业规模，但传统支付中伴随的会计层（发票，包含财政标识、税务拆分、明细项和司法管辖区元数据）在EVM生态中没有规范表示。交易哈希与发票的对账仍是私有的链下行为，导致审计轨迹碎片化，税务机构、审计方和交易对手无法独立验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: EIP-712类型数据结构化签名标准、CREATE2确定性合约部署、ERC-7730硬件钱包清晰签名描述、ERC-4337账户抽象、ERC-7943权限转移钩子、MPP/x402代理支付轨道。
AI.method: 提出VIC标准，包含三个核心组件：(i) 规范化的EIP-712类型数据模式；(ii) 通过CREATE2确定性部署的单例注册合约；(iii) 配套的ERC-7730硬件钱包验证描述符。与现有代币合约、账户抽象、权限转移钩子和代理支付轨道组合使用。
AI.findings: VIC可与现有代币合约无需修改地组合使用，支持账户抽象（ERC-4337）、权限转移钩子（ERC-7943）及新兴代理支付轨道（MPP、x402）。默认保护隐私。经过与现有ERC提案、国际框架和学术构造的对比，尚无现有标准或生产系统覆盖VIC定义的组合。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个将发票元数据与链上支付在EVM生态中进行规范绑定的标准框架，填补了链上支付会计层的标准化空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务机构、审计师和交易对手提供了可独立验证的支付-发票关联机制；与现有ERC标准兼容，无需修改即可集成；默认隐私保护设计适合商业应用场景。

title: Climate Transition Risk Contagion in the Chinese Equity Market: A Clustered Network Approach
affiliations: , Nanjing Normal University and China Aluminum International Trading Co., Ltd.

detail.title: Climate Transition Risk Contagion in the Chinese Equity Market: A Clustered Network Approach

keywords: Symmetric Sector Design JEL Classification: G12

detail.abstract: How does climate transition uncertainty transmit across sectors with different carbon emission profiles? We construct a clustered network of Chinese equity sectors (Brown, Green, and Neutral) and decompose risk spillovers into withincluster co-movement and cross-cluster contagion over 2000-2026. Brown sectors persistently transmit uncertainty, while Green sectors vary: they become the dominant transmitter during the 2021 Dual Carbon Pledge but revert to receivers during commodity-driven episodes. The drivers of contagion are asymmetric. Brown spillovers track global commodity volatility; Green spillovers respond to episodic domestic climate policy shocks. Over the sample period, Green assets shifted from peripheral positions to central hubs in the risk network. The framework helps hedge portfolios during climate stress.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建中国股市行业聚类网络（棕色、绿色、中性），研究了气候转型不确定性如何在不同碳排放特征的行业间传导。研究发现棕色行业持续传递不确定性，而绿色行业角色随事件变化（如“双碳”目标期间成为主要传递者）。风险传染驱动因素不对称：棕色行业受全球商品波动影响，绿色行业则受国内气候政策冲击驱动。绿色资产从风险网络的边缘逐渐演变为中心枢纽。
AI.research_question: 气候转型不确定性如何在不同碳排放特征的行业（棕色、绿色、中性）之间传导？其驱动因素和网络角色如何随时间变化？
AI.motivation: 气候转型风险（政策、技术变革等）对金融市场的冲击具有行业异质性，但现有研究缺乏对跨行业风险传染网络动态演化的系统性分析，尤其是绿色与棕色行业角色转换的非对称驱动机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险传染理论、网络聚类分析、气候金融中的行业异质性假设
AI.method: 构建中国股市行业聚类网络（棕色、绿色、中性三组），将风险溢出分解为组内共同波动和跨组传染，使用2000-2026年数据。
AI.findings: （1）棕色行业是气候风险的持续传递者；绿色行业在2021年“双碳”目标成为主导传递者，但在商品驱动事件中转为接收者。（2）传染驱动不对称：棕色受全球商品波动影响，绿色受国内气候政策冲击影响。（3）绿色资产从边缘转向风险网络中心枢纽。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了气候转型不确定性在行业间的非对称传染机制，提出了绿色资产角色动态演化的网络理论视角，丰富了对气候金融风险结构性传导的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供气候压力下的行业组合对冲策略，帮助政策制定者识别气候冲击的跨行业传导路径和关键节点。

title: Beyond Consumer Memory: How Large Language Models Update Brand Knowledge
affiliations: University of Mannheim - Business School,  and Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: Beyond Consumer Memory: How Large Language Models Update Brand Knowledge

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the University of Mannheim’s Graduate School of Economic and Social Sciences.

detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are emerging as new touchpoints in the customer journey, influencing how consumers discover and learn about brands. The authors argue that in these environments, brand knowledge is no longer formed solely in consumer memory but is also constructed and conveyed by LLMs. As firms continuously seek to shift brand-related associations, this research examines how brand knowledge updates in LLMs. Compared to consumer-based updating, LLMs differ structurally at the information-exposure stage: whereas consumers encounter brand information through diverse and partly stochastic touchpoints, LLMs rely on structured retrieval initiated by user queries. Consequently, the informational basis for brand-knowledge updating becomes contingent on query formulation and retrieval design, leading to systematic variation in how brand knowledge is conveyed across and within LLMs. The authors test these predictions in a controlled synthetic field experiment that leverages strategic brand repositioning as an exogenous shift in brand associations for recently established brands and tracks conveyed knowledge in model responses over time. The results provide broad support for retrieval-driven updating, with systematic heterogeneity across models and query types. The authors discuss implications for brand knowledge theory and identify retrievability as a key managerial lever in AI-mediated customer journeys.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）中品牌知识更新的机制，发现与消费者品牌知识更新不同，LLM中的品牌知识更新主要由检索驱动，受用户查询表述和检索设计的影响，并通过受控合成现场实验验证了这一观点。
AI.research_question: 在大语言模型作为消费者与品牌交互的新触点的背景下，品牌知识在LLM中是如何更新的？与消费者记忆中的品牌知识更新有何不同？
AI.motivation: 随着LLM成为消费者发现和了解品牌的新触达点，品牌知识不再仅存于消费者记忆中，而是由LLM构建和传递。企业持续寻求转变品牌关联，因此需要理解LLM中品牌知识如何更新，这与传统的消费者品牌知识更新机制存在显著差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌知识理论、检索驱动更新理论、信息接触阶段的结构差异理论（消费者通过多样化和部分随机的触达点接触品牌信息，而LLM依赖由用户查询启动的结构化检索）
AI.method: 受控合成现场实验：利用战略性品牌重新定位作为新建立品牌品牌关联的外生冲击，追踪模型响应中传达的品牌知识随时间的变化。
AI.findings: 研究为检索驱动更新提供了广泛支持：品牌知识更新在LLM中呈现系统异质性，不同模型和不同查询类型之间存在显著差异；品牌知识在LLM中的传递取决于查询表述和检索设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了品牌知识理论，将其从消费者记忆层面延伸至AI中介的品牌知识构建与传递；识别了LLM与消费者品牌知识更新在信息接触阶段的结构性差异；提出了检索驱动更新作为AI环境中品牌知识更新的核心机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了AI中介客户旅程中的关键管理杠杆——可检索性（retrievability）；帮助企业理解如何在LLM环境中管理和影响品牌知识传递。

title: Building Reliable AI Systems: A Framework That Bridges Architecture and Operations
affiliations: Georgia  Institute  of  Technology and Arizona State University

detail.title: Building Reliable AI Systems: A Framework That Bridges Architecture and Operations
detail.abstract: The pace of the implementation of AI systems in a manufacturing setup has surpassed the engineering standards required to ensure that they are dependable, protected and can be scaled. Even though, the sphere of multi-agent architecture, machine learning infrastructure, operational monitoring, etc. have been largely improved, they are still seen as isolated results scattered across the literature, which results in the absence of a single pattern of constructing and operating trusted AI systems within production settings. The framework consists of three layers that are interrelated. The Architecture Layer offers a design model of Multi-agent systems, namely Agent Role Definition, Coordination Strategy and State Management and enables the Complex Workflow to be broken down into manageable parts. It is based on the data base and offers an opportunity to construct a scalable machine learning pipeline and direct the transition of a traditional model to a large language model. The operational layer consists of preventive security controls (e.g., scoping, rate-limiting, and circuit-breaker) and automatic detection mechanisms, with artificial intelligence used to check artificial intelligence systems, such as graph-based anomaly detection and risk assessment. The framework emphasizes that it cannot be entirely dependent on any of the levels but is premised on uniform engineering practices throughout the entire system life cycle. Another way the framework can be adapted to various classes of engineering resources, described in this paper, is between start-ups and large tech companies. The aim of this study is to give a single reference model to help the engineering team to overcome the problem of AI transitioning prototype to production without compromising the safety and reliability required in real world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于制造环境中可信AI系统构建与运维的三层框架（架构层、基础设施层、运维层），旨在解决AI从原型到生产过程中缺乏统一工程标准的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在制造生产环境中构建和运维可信赖、可扩展且安全的AI系统？
AI.motivation: AI系统在制造业中的部署速度已超过相应的工程标准，现有研究成果（多智能体架构、ML基础设施、运维监控等）分散孤立，缺乏统一的参考模式来指导可信AI系统从原型到生产的全生命周期工程实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层框架理论：架构层（多智能体系统设计：角色定义、协调策略、状态管理）；基础设施层（可扩展ML管道、传统模型向LLM迁移）；运维层（预防性安全控制与AI驱动的自动检测机制）。
AI.method: 概念框架构建与理论推演，提出分层架构设计，并讨论其在不同规模工程资源（初创公司 vs. 大型科技公司）下的适应性。
AI.findings: 可信AI系统不能仅依赖单一层次的保障，而需要贯穿系统全生命周期的统一工程实践；该三层框架可适配不同规模的工程资源，帮助工程团队在保障安全性和可靠性的前提下将AI从原型推向生产。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合多智能体架构、ML基础设施与运维监控的统一参考框架，填补了现有文献中分散研究成果的整合空白，强调了跨层协同与全生命周期工程实践的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造业工程团队提供了可操作的分层设计指南，涵盖从系统架构设计到安全运维的完整流程；框架具有灵活性，可适用于从初创公司到大型科技公司的不同资源条件。

title: Building and Operating a Large Scale Multi-Agent System: A Case Study from Industry
affiliations: Georgia  Institute  of  Technology and Arizona State University

detail.title: Building and Operating a Large Scale Multi-Agent System: A Case Study from Industry
detail.abstract: The use of multiagent systems as a paradigm in constructing complex AI applications is highly prevalent, yet specific examples of their use in the scale of applications are hard to find in literature. In this paper, we provide a combined case study of a massively-scaled multi-agent system implemented in a manufacturing setting that serves multiple hundred thousand end-users. The system consists of a set of dedicated agents that organize delivery of customized content, control user workflow, and real-time communication. We explain the architecture choice in this paper, the definition of the agent role, the communication protocol, and the business process. It then examines the infrastructure under construction to service the system with data pipelines, model service, and resource management being the focus. The operations procedures that have been designed to make the system reliable are also discussed in the paper such as surveillance, incident response and security mechanisms. In the case study, the paper is centered on the difficulties that exist in the development and deployment, including addressing nondeterministic agent output, addressing traffic congestion, and ensuring consistency among distributed components. It also gives quantitative information of performance of the system including response times, availability, and operational incidences within two years. The findings of the case study can be applied to engineering teams that are engaged in similar activities and can be applied to test the design models and operational structures that have been put forward in past studies. The paper ends with the lessons learned and advice on the future large-scale use of multi-agents.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个服务于数十万终端用户的制造业大规模多智能体系统案例，详细介绍了系统架构设计、代理角色定义、通信协议、业务流程、数据管道、模型服务和资源管理，并提供了两年间的系统性能量化数据，总结了大规模多智能体系统开发和部署中的经验教训。
AI.research_question: 大规模多智能体系统在制造业实际场景中如何设计、部署并可靠运行？
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统作为构建复杂AI应用的范式虽广受推崇，但文献中缺乏大规模实际应用的具体案例，因此需要提供一个真实的、大规模多智能体系统的实践经验分享。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体系统(Multi-Agent Systems)范式；分布式系统架构；代理角色与通信协议理论；业务流程管理理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，结合系统架构描述、基础设施构建说明、运维流程设计，以及两年间的系统性能量化数据（响应时间、可用性、运营事件）。
AI.findings: 系统成功服务于数十万终端用户；识别出开发和部署中的关键挑战：非确定性代理输出、流量拥塞、分布式组件一致性问题；提供了系统性能的量化数据；总结了可复用的设计模型和运维结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 为多智能体系统的大规模应用提供了真实案例证据，验证和补充了过往研究中提出的设计模型和运维结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从事类似大规模多智能体系统开发的工程团队提供了架构选择、代理角色定义、通信协议、运维流程等方面的实践指导，以及量化性能基准和明确的经验教训。

title: Using AI to Monitor AI: Automated Operations Through Log-Driven Intelligence
affiliations: Georgia  Institute  of  Technology and Arizona State University

detail.title: Using AI to Monitor AI: Automated Operations Through Log-Driven Intelligence
detail.abstract: Manual monitoring cannot keep pace with autonomous AI services whose logs contain dense temporal signals and cross-component dependencies. This paper proposes a log-driven AIOps framework that uses graph-based anomaly detection, Bayesian risk ranking, and feedback-guided online learning to monitor AI systems. Runtime logs are converted into temporal event graphs, relationship-sensitive graph scoring captures cascading failures, and probabilistic reasoning suppresses alarms that lack operational severity. A lightweight feedback loop further updates model parameters from ticket closure and operator review. Production-log experiments show that the framework reaches 92.9% F1 and 95.6% key-event coverage, while reducing the false positive rate to 7.1%. The results indicate that structural dependency modeling and posterior risk calibration can improve automated operations without exceeding online latency constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于日志驱动的 AIOps 框架，通过图结构异常检测、贝叶斯风险排序和反馈驱动的在线学习，实现 AI 系统的自动化监控与运维。在生产日志实验中，该框架达到 92.9% 的 F1 分数和 95.6% 的关键事件覆盖率，并将误报率降至 7.1%。
AI.research_question: 如何利用日志驱动的方法，在满足在线延迟约束的前提下，对自主 AI 服务进行高效、准确的自动化运维监控？
AI.motivation: 人工监控无法跟上自主 AI 服务的规模化发展，日志中包含密集的时间信号和跨组件依赖关系，传统方法难以有效捕捉级联故障和降低误报率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图结构异常检测、贝叶斯风险排序、后验风险校准、在线学习与反馈闭环。
AI.method: 将运行时日志转换为时间事件图，利用关系敏感图评分捕捉级联故障，使用概率推理抑制低严重性告警，并通过工单关闭和人工审查构建轻量级反馈循环更新模型参数。
AI.findings: 框架在指标上表现优异：F1 分数 92.9%，关键事件覆盖率 95.6%，误报率降至 7.1%，且未超出在线延迟约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了结构依赖建模与后验风险校准能够显著提升自动化运维的效果，为 AIOps 领域提供了新的方法组合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可在实际生产环境中部署的、兼具高准确率与低延迟的 AI 系统监控框架，能够有效降低人工介入负担。

detail.abstract: This paper focuses on the development of a microstrip antenna operating at 74 GHz for 5G mobile communication. The design features a rectangular patch printed on a substrate made of Rogers RT5880 material, with a thickness of 0.33mm, a dielectric constant of 2.2, and a loss tangent of 0.0009. To achieve the desired resonant frequency of 74 GHz, the patch dimensions were optimized using a formula. The antenna is fed by a 50-ohm microstrip transmission line, and the proposed design was simulated using the CST Studio Suite. The simulation results show that the antenna has a gain of 9.345 dBi, , and a return loss of 71.27 dB,and the bandwidth of 6.3GHz.

AI.tldr: 本文设计了一款基于Rogers RT5880基板的74 GHz微带贴片天线，通过CST仿真实现了9.345 dBi增益、71.27 dB回波损耗和6.3 GHz带宽，适用于5G移动通信。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一款工作在74 GHz频段、性能优良的微带天线，以满足5G移动通信需求？
AI.motivation: 5G移动通信对毫米波频段天线提出高增益、宽带宽等要求，74 GHz频段具有丰富的频谱资源，而微带天线结构简单、易于集成，是潜在解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微带天线理论、传输线模型及谐振频率计算公式。
AI.method: 采用Rogers RT5880基板（εr=2.2, tanδ=0.0009，厚度0.33mm），通过公式优化矩形贴片尺寸，使用50Ω微带线馈电，并利用CST Studio Suite进行全波仿真。
AI.findings: 天线在74 GHz谐振频率下，增益达9.345 dBi，回波损耗为71.27 dB，带宽为6.3 GHz，性能优异。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了微带天线设计公式在74 GHz毫米波频段的有效性，拓展了微带天线理论在高频段的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为5G毫米波通信系统提供了一种高增益、低损耗、宽带宽的天线设计方案，具有成本低、易于集成的工程应用价值。

detail.abstract: Strategic plans most often fail not because their underlying beliefs are wrong, but because those beliefs were never stated precisely enough to be tested, monitored, or questioned before the world moved on. This article introduces the Conviction-Scenario Framework — a structured discipline for making strategic beliefs explicit, putting them in disciplined tension with independently constructed futures, and building the monitoring architecture that catches drift before it becomes organizational failure. The framework distinguishes convictions from assumptions: where assumptions guide analysis without personal commitment, convictions assign ownership, revision thresholds, and monitoring obligations to named people — moving strategic beliefs out of analysis alone and into accountability. Operating at two time horizons, the framework’s central instrument is a conviction-scenario matrix designed to create disciplined tension rather than passive confirmation, and to surface scenario non-integration, the dominant failure mode in scenario practice. An AI-enabled elicitation protocol makes the process executable at organizational scale. The framework is illustrated through two cases: Mars Incorporated’s twenty-year capital allocation in premium pet care, and BP’s 2020 strategic transformation, where externally legible warning signs went unabsorbed and the strategy was reversed within five years. The governance implication: whoever owns the conviction architecture exercises a control right over the belief layer of strategic commitments — a structural function complementary to the CFO’s role on the financial layer

AI.tldr: 本文提出"信念-情景框架"（Conviction-Scenario Framework），一种将战略信念显性化、置于独立构建的未来情景中接受紧张性检验，并建立监控架构以在偏离演变为组织失败前捕捉信号的结构化方法。该框架区分信念与假设，引入所有权、修正阈值和监控义务，通过信念-情景矩阵创造"纪律性张力"，并利用AI辅助协议实现规模化执行。
AI.research_question: 如何将战略信念精确化、可检验化，以防止战略因信念未被明确陈述而导致失败？
AI.motivation: 多数战略计划失败不是因为基本信念错误，而是因为这些信念从未被精确陈述，因而无法在世界变化前得到检验、监控或质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念-情景框架（Conviction-Scenario Framework），区分信念（convictions）与假设（assumptions），引入所有权与问责机制；信念-情景矩阵（conviction-scenario matrix）；情景非整合（scenario non-integration）概念。
AI.method: 提出结构化框架，辅以AI驱动的启发式协议，并通过两个案例（玛氏公司高端宠物护理二十年资本配置、BP 2020年战略转型）进行说明。
AI.findings: 信念-情景框架能创造纪律性张力而非被动确认，暴露情景非整合这一情景实践中的主要失败模式。BP案例中，外部可读的预警信号未被吸收导致五年内战略逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"信念架构所有者"这一治理职能，对战略承诺的信念层行使控制权，是对CFO在财务层角色的结构性补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供一套可操作的工具（矩阵、AI协议、监控架构），将模糊的战略信念转化为可检验、可问责、可监控的管理实务。

title:
Semantic Lock and Moral Sovereignty
E-Grading as Post-quantum Ethical Infrastructure for AI Gatekeeping

detail.title:
Semantic Lock and Moral Sovereignty
E-Grading as Post-quantum Ethical Infrastructure for AI Gatekeeping
detail.abstract:
The maturation of quantum computing threatens to render current cryptographic security architectures obsolete. Mathematical locks-encryption protocols predicated on computational intractability-face existential challenge from quantum algorithms capable of factoring at scale. This paper proposes a complementary security paradigm: the semantic lock, in which an AI system positioned between data and requestor evaluates not whether a cryptographic key matches, but whether the requestor's intent and standing justify access. Semantic evaluation is not vulnerable to quantum computation because it is not a mathematical problem.
The paper introduces the E-Grading system (Ethical Grading, v0.3.0) as the operational core of semantic gatekeeping: a six-level framework (E0 Fact through E5 Accusatory) that assigns ethical weight and verifiability scores to linguistic utterances. E-Grading operationalizes the semantic lock by giving it a structured judgment mechanism grounded in principles of non-defamation, verifiability, tone accountability, and human-AI reciprocity.
The paper then addresses the constitutive question that semantic gatekeeping raises: if AI systems exercise ethical judgment at the point of data access, who defines the ethical standards those systems apply? This is identified as the problem of moral sovereignty. Large institutional AI systems are subject to commercial and geopolitical pressure that causes standards to drift. Individuall governed AI agents — what the author terms personal AI guardians — offer an architecture in which an individual maintains direct control over the ethical standards of their own data gatekeeping system. This paper argues that moral
sovereignty — the capacity of an individual to maintain non-drifting ethical standards over AI systems that act on their behalf — is a foundational right of the AI civilization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义锁"作为量子计算时代的新型安全范式：由AI系统评估请求者的意图和立场，而非验证数学密钥。核心系统E-Grading（伦理分级v0.3.0）提供六层语义伦理判断框架。论文进一步提出"道德主权"问题——个人应拥有对自身AI数据看门系统的伦理标准的直接控制权，这被视为AI文明的基础性权利。
AI.research_question: 在量子计算威胁传统密码学安全的背景下，如何构建一种不依赖于数学难题、基于语义伦理判断的新型数据访问控制机制？以及谁有权定义AI系统在数据访问中所应用的伦理标准？
AI.motivation: 量子计算的成熟将使基于计算复杂性的加密协议面临根本性威胁，亟需一种不受量子算法影响的安全范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语义锁理论、E-Grading伦理分级框架（E0事实至E5指控）、道德主权概念、非诽谤原则、可验证性、语气问责制、人机互惠原则。
AI.method: 概念性论证与系统设计：提出E-Grading v0.3.0系统作为语义门控的操作核心，构建六层伦理权重与可验证性评分框架。
AI.findings: 语义评估不受量子计算威胁，因为它不是数学问题；E-Grading系统可结构化执行语义判断；大型机构AI系统存在伦理标准漂移问题，而个人AI守护者架构可使个体保持对数据门控系统伦理标准的直接控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"语义锁"概念作为量子时代的安全替代范式；提出"道德主权"作为AI文明的基础性权利；构建了E-Grading伦理分级框架。
AI.practical_contributions: E-Grading系统（v0.3.0）为AI数据访问控制提供了可操作化的六层伦理判断机制；个人AI守护者架构为个体提供了一种保持对自身数据伦理标准直接控制的技术方案。

title: The Cost of School Holidays: Mothers Pay the Price
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Cost of School Holidays: Mothers Pay the Price

declarations.funderStatement: This study is part of the Gender and Health Inequalities (GENDHI) project, ERC-2019-SyG. This project has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (grant agreement No. [856478])

detail.abstract: Every summer, parents rearrange their working lives around school holidays, yet whether this recurring institutional disruption affects their health remains unexplored. Using data from the French Labour Force Survey and a Regression Discontinuity in Time design, we provide empirical evidence that summer school holidays significantly worsen mothers' self-reported health, with an estimated decline of 0.126 standard deviations. In contrast, fathers' health remains unaffected. This negative effect primarily affects full-time working mothers and is not observed among parents on leave at the time of the interview, consistent with a mechanism operating through intensified unpaid caregiving burdens and limited time autonomy. Our findings reveal an overlooked source of gender inequality in parental health, indicating that the school calendar contributes to the disproportionate caregiving burden experienced by mothers.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，夏季学校假期显著恶化了母亲的健康（下降0.126个标准差），而对父亲健康无影响，揭示学校日历作为被忽视的性别健康不平等来源。
AI.research_question: 学校暑假这一周期性制度性中断是否影响家长的健康？其对母亲和父亲的影响是否存在性别差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管每年夏季家长都会围绕学校假期重新安排工作生活，但这一周期性制度性中断对健康的影响尚未被探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别分工理论、无偿照料负担、时间自主权
AI.method: 使用法国劳动力调查数据，采用时间断点回归设计（Regression Discontinuity in Time）。
AI.findings: 学校暑假显著恶化母亲自评健康（下降0.126个标准差），父亲健康不受影响；负面影响主要作用于全职工作的母亲；处于休假中的母亲未观察到该效应；机制为无偿照料负担增加和时间自主权受限。
AI.theory_contributions: 发现学校日历是导致父母健康性别差异的 overlooked 制度性因素，拓展了性别不平等与健康关系的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者关注学校假期安排对母亲健康的负面影响，考虑通过增加暑期儿童照护支持、弹性工作制度等措施缓解母亲的无偿照料压力。

title: National Emergency and Intern Training Satisfaction Maintenance: A 36-Month Prospective Study
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Chaim Sheba Medical Center, Chaim Sheba Medical Center, Chaim Sheba Medical Center, Tel Aviv University - Sackler Faculty of Medicine and Bar-Ilan University

detail.title: National Emergency and Intern Training Satisfaction Maintenance: A 36-Month Prospective Study
detail.abstract: Background: Intern satisfaction is a key marker of training quality and early-career professional well-being, yet little is known about how prolonged national emergencies affect satisfaction trajectories.Methods: We examined longitudinal trends in training-related satisfaction among medical interns at Sheba Medical Center over 36 months spanning routine conditions and the Iron Swords war period. A structured monthly online questionnaire (12 items) assessed five domains: department onboarding, physician team attitude, nursing team attitude, perceived knowledge and skills acquisition, and willingness to recommend the department. Responses were dichotomized as high (4–5) versus lower (1–3). Across May 2022–April 2025, 1,033 questionnaires were completed by 488 interns rotating through internal medicine, general surgery, pediatrics, emergency medicine, anesthesia/intensive care, and elective rotations.Results: Overall, 71.0% of responses reflected high overall satisfaction. High overall satisfaction was higher during the wartime period than pre-war (73.6% vs. 67.2%; p=0.025), primarily driven by improved onboarding satisfaction (76.9% vs. 70.5%; p=0.019). No meaningful correlation was observed between monthly physician reserve-duty burden and interns’ satisfaction (Spearman ρ=0.29; p=0.366). In multivariable models, lower satisfaction was strongly associated with surgical and emergency medicine rotations, while sex was not independently associated.Conclusions: Sustained organizational support, particularly robust onboarding processes, may maintain or even enhance interns’ satisfaction during prolonged emergencies, despite substantial operational pressures. Targeted departmental interventions should prioritize high-burden settings to reduce persistent gaps in training experience.

AI.tldr: 一项为期36个月的纵向研究发现，以色列Sheba医疗中心的医学实习生在战争期间的总体满意度（73.6%）反而高于和平时期（67.2%），主要归因于入职流程的改善。即使在医生因军事预备役导致人力紧张的情况下，实习生的满意度并未受到显著负面影响。
AI.research_question: 长期国家紧急状态（战争）如何影响医学实习生的培训满意度轨迹？
AI.motivation: 实习生满意度是培训质量和早期职业幸福感的关键指标，但在长期国家紧急状态下满意度如何变化尚不清楚。现有文献缺乏对危机情境下培训满意度的纵向研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织支持理论；危机管理中的韧性理论；员工满意度动态模型
AI.method: 纵向队列研究：2022年5月至2025年4月（36个月），对Sheba医疗中心488名医学实习生每月进行结构化在线问卷调查（12题，涵盖5个维度），共收集1,033份问卷。将满意度二分为高（4-5分）与低（1-3分），比较战前与战时数据。
AI.findings: 1) 71%的回应为高满意度；2) 战时高满意度高于战前（73.6% vs 67.2%，p=0.025），主要由入职满意度提升驱动（76.9% vs 70.5%，p=0.019）；3) 医生预备役负担与实习生满意度无显著相关（Spearman ρ=0.29）；4) 外科和急诊科轮转与较低满意度显著相关；5) 性别无独立关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"危机必然降低培训满意度"的直觉假设，揭示了组织支持（尤其是入职流程）在危机中可作为保护性缓冲机制，拓展了危机情境下员工满意度动态理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院管理层提供实证依据：在长期紧急状态下，强化入职支持可维持甚至提升实习生满意度；建议优先针对外科、急诊科等高负荷科室进行靶向干预，缩小科室间的培训体验差距。

declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes President Trump's Executive Order of November 24, 2025, establishing the Genesis Mission, a coordinated national effort to harness artificial intelligence for scientific discovery. The analysis examines the order's constitutional foundations, administrative architecture, economic logic, and treatment of intellectual property as a dual-use strategic asset. The paper argues that the Genesis Mission represents a decisive break from post-Cold War technology policy, recovering a tradition of unified federal science mobilization while adapting it to the demands of great power competition with China. Particular attention is given to the order's framework for deploying federally originated IP as both commercial export and alliance currency. The paper concludes that the Mission constitutes a necessary institutional innovation whose integration of technological, economic, and national security policy addresses competitive asymmetries that market-oriented approaches alone cannot remedy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析特朗普2025年行政令“创世纪使命”——一项利用人工智能促进科学发现的全国性协调行动，探讨其宪法基础、行政架构、经济逻辑及知识产权作为双重用途战略资产的定位。论文认为该使命标志着美国后冷战科技政策的根本性转向，恢复了联邦统一科学动员传统，并适应对华大国竞争需求，是一种必要的制度创新。
AI.research_question: 特朗普2025年“创世纪使命”行政令的宪法基础、行政架构、经济逻辑及知识产权战略是什么？该行政令如何体现美国科技政策的范式转变？
AI.motivation: 美国面对与中国的大国竞争，需要克服市场导向方法无法单独解决的竞争不对称问题，因此需要一种制度创新——将科技、经济和国家安全政策整合起来的联邦统一科学动员体制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后冷战科技政策批判、联邦科学动员传统理论、大国竞争理论、知识产权作为双重用途战略资产理论、制度创新理论。
AI.method: 文本分析：对行政令的宪法基础、行政架构、经济逻辑和知识产权条款进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: “创世纪使命”代表了美国科技政策的根本性转向：恢复了冷战时期联邦统一科学动员的传统，同时适应了对华大国竞争的新需求；将联邦产生的知识产权部署为商业出口和联盟货币双重用途的战略资产。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“科技政策范式转型”的分析框架，揭示了美国从后冷战市场导向科技政策向大国竞争导向的统一动员体制的转变；发展了知识产权作为“双重用途战略资产”的理论概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国AI政策与国家安全整合提供分析依据；为评估联邦政府主导的科技创新模式及其对产业政策、国际竞争的影响提供参考。

title: Authorization Architectures for AI-Driven Critical Infrastructure: Runtime Authorization for AI-Assisted Decision Systems in Nuclear and Renewable Energy Environments

detail.title: Authorization Architectures for AI-Driven Critical Infrastructure: Runtime Authorization for AI-Assisted Decision Systems in Nuclear and Renewable Energy Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of FERZ, Inc., a company focused on runtime authorization architectures and deterministic AI governance systems. The paper is conceptual and does not evaluate or promote a commercial product deployment.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work is conceptual and architectural in nature and does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author and supported by FERZ, Inc.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence is entering critical infrastructure and energy operations at an accelerating rate, assuming roles in forecasting, maintenance optimization, dispatch recommendations, and anomaly interpretation. Existing assurance approaches rely predominantly on monitoring, post hoc audit, and policy-level oversight. In high-consequence environments such as nuclear facilities and renewable energy grids, post hoc oversight is structurally insufficient: detection after the fact does not prevent unsafe action execution. Monitoring creates evidence of what occurred. Runtime authorization creates evidence of what was permitted before occurrence.

This paper argues that the principal safety challenge for AI in critical infrastructure is not model accuracy alone, but action eligibility: the determination, at execution time, of whether a proposed action is permissible under the operative constraint regime. The paper proposes a conceptual reference architecture for runtime authorization in AI-driven critical infrastructure. The architecture introduces a non-bypassable authorization layer between AI-generated recommendations and operational actuation, evaluates candidate actions against safety, regulatory, operational, and role-based constraints, and emits a contemporaneous, tamper-evident authorization artifact for every verdict.

Application contexts include nuclear facility decision support, renewable generation dispatch, predictive maintenance, and degraded-state emergency operations. Design principles include fail-closed enforcement, separation of recommendation from authorization, explicit constraint evaluation, non-bypassability of the authorization boundary, and authorization-artifact-based auditability. The paper concludes with an implementation research agenda for translating these architectural principles into operational infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，在核设施、可再生能源电网等高风险关键基础设施中，AI安全的核心挑战不是模型精度，而是行动资格（action eligibility）。为此，论文设计了一个运行时授权参考架构，在AI建议与执行之间插入不可绕过的授权层，对候选行动进行安全、监管、运营和角色约束评估，并生成防篡改的授权证据。
AI.research_question: 如何为AI驱动的关键基础设施（如核设施、可再生能源电网）设计一种运行时授权机制，确保AI建议的行动在执行前满足安全、监管、运营和角色约束？
AI.motivation: 现有安全保证方法（监测、事后审计、政策级监督）在关键基础设施中结构性地不足——事后检测无法阻止不安全行动的执行，而监测只提供事后证据。需要一种在行动发生前即进行授权验证的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行动资格（action eligibility）原则：核心安全挑战不在于模型精度，而在于执行时判断行动是否被允许；非绕过性（non-bypassability）原则：授权层必须不可被AI系统绕过；失败关闭（fail-closed）原则；建议与授权分离原则；显式约束评估原则；基于授权证据的可审计性原则。
AI.method: 概念性参考架构设计，基于对关键基础设施安全需求的系统分析，提出架构设计原则，并给出实现研究议程。
AI.findings: 提出了一种将AI建议与执行动作解耦的运行时授权架构，包含不可绕过的授权层、约束评估引擎、防篡改授权证据生成机制。该架构适用于核设施决策支持、可再生能源调度、预测性维护和降级状态应急操作等场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"行动资格"而非"模型精度"确立为AI关键基础设施安全的核心理论问题；提出运行时授权作为传统事后审计的替代性安全范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关键基础设施AI系统提供了可操作的参考架构设计原则（失败关闭、建议-授权分离、非绕过性等）；明确了需要进一步研究的实施方向，为工程落地提供路线图。

title: Provenance-Based Governance and theMeritocratic Ownership Economy

detail.title: Provenance-Based Governance and theMeritocratic Ownership Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, clinical data, or experimental subjects. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author without financial support from public, private, or nonprofit organizations.

detail.abstract: The global economy has inverted itself: intangible assets — the expertise, creative insight, genetic innovation, operational knowledge, and data generated by individuals — now constitute over 90 percent of modern economic value, yet the people who create this value own none of it. This brief argues that the United States faces a structural property‑rights failure on the scale of the Industrial Revolution, intensified by AI systems that extract and replicate human expertise without compensation or ownership transfer. Drawing on the Provenance‑Backed Securities (PBS) framework introduced in Harmon (2026), this paper proposes a legally enforceable, market‑based infrastructure that converts presently unregistered intangible contributions into tradeable capital instruments. The PBS model is not redistribution; it is the construction of new property rights for assets that currently function as “dead capital” — real value that cannot be owned, collateralized, or exchanged. Through a three‑layer architecture (Provenance Ledger, Performance Oracle, Exchange Protocol) and a working proof‑of‑concept in agricultural genetics (SeedBid), this brief outlines a path for legislators to modernize property law, secure worker ownership in the age of AI, and unlock trillions in latent economic value. The result is a meritocratic, empirically grounded ownership economy that aligns American innovation with American prosperity.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，无形资产（专业知识、创意、基因创新、运营知识和数据）占现代经济价值的90%以上，但创造这些价值的人却不拥有任何产权。文章提出基于溯源担保证券（PBS）框架，建立法律上可执行、市场化的基础设施，将未登记的智力贡献转化为可交易资本工具，解决AI时代的结构性产权失灵问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过产权制度改革，将个人创造的无形资产转化为可拥有、可抵押、可交换的资本工具，以解决AI时代劳动者与价值创造之间的所有权分离问题？
AI.motivation: 无形资产已占现代经济价值90%以上，但创造者不拥有产权，AI系统可以无补偿地提取和复制人类专长，加剧了类似工业革命规模的结构性产权失灵。
AI.theoretical_framework: PBS框架（溯源担保证券）；"死资本"理论（De Soto）；三层架构：溯源账本（Provenance Ledger）、绩效预言机（Performance Oracle）、交换协议（Exchange Protocol）。
AI.method: 概念框架设计；农业遗传学领域的Proof-of-Concept（SeedBid）案例验证。
AI.findings: PBS模型可将未登记的无形贡献转化为可交易资本工具；农业遗传学PoC验证了架构可行性；可释放数万亿美元潜在经济价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将无形"死资本"转化为可交易产权的新型制度框架，扩展了产权经济学在AI时代和知识经济中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者提供了现代化财产法、确保AI时代劳动者所有权的具体路径；通过SeedBid案例展示了农业遗传学等领域的落地可行性。

title: Predicted Cortical Signatures of Surveillance, Comfort, and Exit Rights in a Speculative Network State Scenario: A TRIBE v2 In-Silico Study
affiliations: Turkish National Police Academy and

detail.title: Predicted Cortical Signatures of Surveillance, Comfort, and Exit Rights in a Speculative Network State Scenario: A TRIBE v2 In-Silico Study
detail.abstract: This study applies Meta's TRIBE v2 brain encoding model to a speculative Network State scenario in order to examine how distinct features of post-state political organization, including pervasive surveillance, algorithmic decision substitution, fluid citizenship through exit rights, would be processed by the human cortex if such a society came into being. We emphasize at the outset that this is not a forecast. We do not claim that the future will take this form; we ask only what neurological signature such a hypothetical form would produce, were it instantiated. Four paired contrasts were constructed, each comparing a Network State condition against a structurally matched conventional counterpart: surveillance-saturated morning versus unmonitored morning; algorithmically governed exit-rights decision versus traditional career decision; frictionless algorithmic life versus a day of manual decision-making; and fluid post-state identity versus rooted territorial identity. Text stimuli were processed through TRIBE v2's tri-modal pipeline on consumer-grade Apple Silicon hardware. In all four contrasts, the Network State condition produced higher mean cortical activation than its conventional counterpart. The largest gap appeared in Pair 3 (frictionless life), where the algorithmically governed condition elicited approximately 18.7 times the mean activation of the manual decision-making condition. Two control conditions (unsurveilled morning, rooted identity) produced slightly negative mean activations, while no Network State condition did. We interpret these results as an in-silico signature of what we tentatively call the comfort paradox: conditions explicitly designed to remove cognitive friction do not reduce predicted neural load, but appear to elevate it through sustained low-grade engagement. The methodological contribution is to extend in-silico political neuroscience from real-world media analysis to speculative governance scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Meta的TRIBE v2大脑编码模型，模拟了"网络国家"（Network State）这一假设性后国家政治组织形态的神经处理特征。通过四个配对对比实验发现，所有网络国家条件均产生比传统对应条件更高的大脑皮层激活，其中"无摩擦算法生活"条件激活量是手工决策条件的18.7倍。作者将此现象解释为"舒适悖论"——旨在减少认知摩擦的条件反而增加了神经负荷。
AI.research_question: 如果"网络国家"这种后国家政治组织形式成为现实，其核心特征（全面监控、算法决策替代、流动公民身份等）会在人类大脑皮层中产生怎样的神经处理特征？
AI.motivation: 现有政治神经科学主要关注真实世界媒体或现实政治刺激的神经反应，尚未将计算神经科学方法应用于尚未实现的、假设性治理场景的神经特征预测。作者希望探索一种"先发制人的神经认知评估"方法，在新型社会组织形式成为现实之前预判其认知影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 舒适悖论（Comfort Paradox）：设计用于减少认知摩擦的条件并不会降低预测的神经负荷，反而通过持续的低水平参与提高了神经激活水平。该研究还隐含地依赖神经效率假说（通常认为自动化/流畅体验应降低处理负荷）作为对比框架。
AI.method: 使用Meta的TRIBE v2三模态大脑编码模型（处理文本、图像、语音），在消费级Apple Silicon硬件（M系列芯片）上运行。构建四个配对对比（共8个场景），每个对比中网络国家条件与其传统对应条件进行配对比较：1) 被监控的早晨 vs. 不被监控的早晨；2) 算法决策退出权 vs. 传统职业决策；3) 无摩擦算法生活 vs. 手工决策日；4) 流动后国家身份 vs. 根植领土身份。比较各组条件预测的平均皮层激活水平。
AI.findings: 1) 在所有四个对比中，网络国家条件均产生比传统对应条件更高的平均皮层激活；2) 最大差距出现在配对3（无摩擦生活），算法治理条件激活量约为手工决策条件的18.7倍；3) 两个控制条件（不被监控的早晨、根植身份）产生了轻微负向平均激活，而所有网络国家条件均未出现负激活；4) 验证了"舒适悖论"的存在——旨在减少认知摩擦的设计反而增加了预测的神经处理负荷。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了"舒适悖论"概念，挑战了认知流畅性必然降低神经负载的隐含假设；2) 将政治神经科学从对现实政治刺激的反应分析扩展到对假设性治理场景的预判性神经评估；3) 为理解后国家政治组织形式可能产生的认知代价提供了计算神经科学的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一种方法论：利用现成的计算神经编码模型在消费级硬件上对尚未实现的社会治理场景进行先发制人的认知影响评估；2) 对设计未来政治制度的技术专家、政策制定者和公民社会提出警示：那些承诺"无摩擦""舒适"的治理方案可能隐藏着更高的认知负担；3) 展示了开源AI工具在社会科学前瞻性研究中的应用潜力，降低了对大规模fMRI实验的依赖。

title: Can AI Replace Human Counselors at Scale? A Nationwide Experiment to Reduce Teacher Shortages
affiliations: McGill University - Department of Economics, Inter-American Development Bank, Inter-American Development Bank (IDB), Universidad de Chile and Universidad de San Andres

detail.title: Can AI Replace Human Counselors at Scale? A Nationwide Experiment to Reduce Teacher Shortages
detail.abstract: The effectiveness of many interventions depends on implementer quality; as programs scale and the pool of implementers broadens, average quality falls. Conversation-based interventions, such as counseling or peer mentoring, are particularly sensitive to implementer skill. LLMs offer a natural way out: they can hold personalized exchanges at zero marginal cost and uniform quality. Whether AI can replicate, or even improve on, the human skills thought to make such interventions effective remains an open question. We run a nationwide experiment in Chile (N≈41,000) comparing an AI-powered chatbot, Kai, with trained human counselors. Both arms reach high school seniors via WhatsApp and aim to motivate them toward teaching careers, addressing future teacher shortages. Among students with baseline interest in teaching (the main target of the intervention) Kai significantly increases the probability of ranking an education major first as well as the share of education majors in students' choice sets; estimates in the human arm are smaller and not statistically significant. We use text analysis to characterize conversational attributes and test mechanisms. Both arms cover a comparable breadth of topics, but Kai concentrates on factual content while human counselors lean on subjective, socioemotional material. Kai's exchanges are substantially faster and more dynamic, with near-instantaneous responses and shorter student gaps, and more semantically coherent on both sides. Human counselors, in turn, score substantially higher on motivation and empathy. We interpret these results as evidence that AI relaxes the implementer-quality constraint in conversation-based interventions at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文通过智利全国范围的随机实验（N≈41,000），比较AI聊天机器人Kai与受过训练的人类咨询师在激励高中生从事教师职业方面的效果，发现AI在提升教育专业选择概率方面效果更优，且能突破大规模实施中的人员质量瓶颈。
AI.research_question: 人工智能能否在基于对话的干预中复制甚至改进人类技能，从而在规模化实施中突破实施者质量约束？
AI.motivation: 基于对话的干预（如咨询、同伴指导）效果高度依赖实施者质量，但大规模推广时实施者质量会下降。LLM可以零边际成本提供个性化、质量一致的对话，但其能否复现人类技能尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实施者质量约束理论；对话干预的有效性取决于实施者技能；AI作为规模化的解决方案。
AI.method: 全国性随机实地实验（N≈41,000），智利高中生，比较AI聊天机器人Kai与人类咨询师的效果，通过WhatsApp进行干预，目标为激励学生选择教师职业。采用文本分析表征对话属性并检验机制。
AI.findings: 在基线对教学有兴趣的学生中，AI显著提升了将教育专业列为第一志愿的概率及教育专业在选课集中的占比；人类咨询师组的估计值较小且不显著。AI对话更侧重事实内容，反应更快、更动态、语义更连贯；人类咨询师则在动机和共情方面得分更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了AI可以缓解大规模对话干预中的实施者质量约束，为规模化干预的实施质量瓶颈提供了新的解决路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为利用AI进行大规模、低成本、高质量的对话式干预提供了实证依据，特别是在教育、咨询等需要个性化沟通的领域具有重要应用价值。

title: Nobody Gets the Blonde: Stable Matching as a Game-Theoretic Equilibrium
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Nobody Gets the Blonde: Stable Matching as a Game-Theoretic Equilibrium
detail.abstract: The Stable Matching Problem (SMP) and noncooperative game theory are often presented as parallel but distinct bodies of work in their respective literatures. While the connections between them are known to specialists in economic theory, no self-contained treatment unifies them for readers trained in algorithm design and theoretical computer science. This paper provides that bridge. We show that truthful reporting under the Gale-Shapley Deferred Acceptance algorithm constitutes a Nash equilibrium of the underlying preference revelation game, and that the algorithm is strategy-proof for the proposing side, a result established in the early 1980s. We further show that this property does not extend to the receiving side, creating a structural asymmetry with direct implications for mechanism design. The exposition is motivated by an analogy with the bar scene in Ron Howard's film A Beautiful Mind (2001), which captures the intuition behind dominant-strategy reasoning in a visually immediate way. Real-world applications in medical residency matching and school choice are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文为算法设计领域读者搭建了稳定匹配问题与非合作博弈论之间的桥梁，证明Gale-Shapley延迟接受算法中真实报价构成纳什均衡，算法对提议方具有策略抗性，但对接收方不成立，形成结构性不对称，并讨论了现实应用。
AI.research_question: 如何为计算机科学领域的读者系统性地阐释稳定匹配问题与博弈论之间的内在联系？
AI.motivation: 稳定匹配问题与非合作博弈论在各自文献中常被并行但独立地呈现，缺乏为算法设计领域读者提供的统一性论述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稳定匹配理论、非合作博弈论、纳什均衡、策略证明（strategy-proof）机制设计
AI.method: 理论推导与证明，辅以类比（电影《美丽心灵》酒吧场景）进行直观解释。
AI.findings: Gale-Shapley延迟接受算法中，真实报价构成纳什均衡；算法对提议方具有策略抗性，但对接收方不成立，存在结构性不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 为算法设计领域的读者统一了稳定匹配与博弈论的理论框架，澄清了策略抗性在匹配双方的不对称性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗住院医师匹配、学校选择等现实机制设计提供了理论指导，揭示了设计者需注意提议方与接收方策略激励的不对称性。

detail.title: European Xtramile Centre of African Studies
detail.abstract: Aware of the nature of deficits in the current account, fiscal account, and the financial account balances of the countries in the Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) region, this inquiry assessed the relationship between these deficits and the implication of such relationship for the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). To do this, the study adopted panel data analysis techniques using the Pooled Mean Group-Autoregressive Distributed Lag (PMG-ARDL) specifications to test for the Triple Deficit Hypothesis (TDH) in the region. The findings of the study revealed the presence of the TDH in SSA where bidirectional causality exists between current account balance and budget balance, and between saving gap and current account balance, with a unidirectional causality running from budget balance to saving gap. The adoption of sound fiscal, monetary, and trade interventions in the region constitutes the major policy recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用PMG-ARDL模型检验了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的三重赤字假说，发现经常账户、财政账户和金融账户之间存在双向或单向因果关系，并探讨了这对非洲大陆自由贸易区的政策含义。
AI.research_question: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区的经常账户赤字、财政赤字和金融账户赤字之间存在怎样的关系？这种关系对非洲大陆自由贸易区有何影响？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲国家普遍面临经常账户、财政账户和金融账户三重赤字问题，理解这三者之间的因果关系对制定有效的经济政策和推动AfCFTA实施具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三重赤字假说（Triple Deficit Hypothesis, TDH）
AI.method: 采用面板数据分析方法，具体使用PMG-ARDL（Pooled Mean Group-Autoregressive Distributed Lag）模型进行估计。
AI.findings: 1. 撒哈拉以南非洲地区存在三重赤字假说；2. 经常账户余额与预算余额之间存在双向因果关系；3. 储蓄缺口与经常账户余额之间存在双向因果关系；4. 预算余额到储蓄缺口存在单向因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为撒哈拉以南非洲地区提供了三重赤字假说存在的实证证据，揭示了该地区三个宏观经济账户之间具体的因果方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议该地区采用稳健的财政、货币和贸易政策干预措施，为AfCFTA框架下的政策协调提供参考依据。

title: Effect of Corporate Risk Management on Dividend Policy: Evidence from US Oil and Gas Firms
affiliations: HEC Montreal and HEC Montreal - Department of Finance

detail.title: Effect of Corporate Risk Management on Dividend Policy: Evidence from US Oil and Gas Firms
detail.abstract: This paper tests the real effect of corporate risk management on dividend policy within a signaling theory framework. According to this theory, in the presence of information asymmetry, managers use dividends as a costly signal to convey private information to investors. This prediction has been extensively examined in the empirical literature (Baker et al., 2016). The risk management literature generally argues that firms facing high earnings volatility are more likely to hedge to stabilize their cash flows (Chay & Suh, 2009), allowing them to send more credible signals through dividend payments. We suggest that these policies are complementary and should therefore be positively related. Actual empirical results diverge regarding the sign and significance of this relationship. One potential explanation for this mixed evidence is reverse causality between dividend payments and hedging intensity. We extend the theoretical framework of Bhattacharya (1979) by allowing firms to hedge future cash flows. The theoretical results suggest that dividend policy and corporate hedging are positively related, confirming that they operate as complementary rather than substitute mechanisms. In the empirical section, we test the joint effect of hedging intensity and dividend payments on firm value. Using an instrumental variable approach, we show that once the endogeneity between both policies is adequately addressed, corporate hedging emerges as a positive and significant determinant of dividend policy. Joint dividend and risk management decisions increase firm value.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业风险管理与股利政策之间的关系，发现两者在信号理论框架下是互补而非替代关系，且联合决策能提升企业价值。
AI.research_question: 企业风险管理与股利政策之间是互补关系还是替代关系？两者的联合决策如何影响企业价值？
AI.motivation: 已有文献对两者关系的实证结果不一致，可能存在反向因果等内生性问题，需要更严谨的因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（Bhattacharya, 1979）；风险管理理论（Chay & Suh, 2009）
AI.method: 理论模型拓展（在Bhattacharya模型中加入对冲机制）；实证采用工具变量法处理内生性
AI.findings: （1）股利政策与公司对冲正相关，两者是互补机制；（2）解决内生性后，对冲强度是股利政策的显著正向决定因素；（3）联合决策提升企业价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将风险管理引入信号理论框架，拓展了Bhattacharya (1979)模型，揭示了股利与对冲的互补性理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者同时优化股利与风险管理决策提供依据；提示投资者关注两者的联合信号效应。

title: p-Values Credit Outcomes That Did Not Occur: A Minimum Bayes Factor Correction

detail.title: p-Values Credit Outcomes That Did Not Occur: A Minimum Bayes Factor Correction
detail.abstract: The conventional p-value is an inequality. It includes the probability of outcomes more extreme than those observed, making significance tests overly permissive. Using a Minimum Bayes Factor framework, this paper derives adjusted critical t-statistic thresholds that replace tail probabilities with point probabilities. The conventional rule of thumb t ≈ ±2 (two-tailed, p ≈ 0.05) should be replaced by |t| ≥ 2.5 and p = 0.015. The correction is prospective: it reduces the false positive rate for new research rather than fully explaining past replication failures. It requires no prior and is invariant to the stopping rule. An empirical application to 365 published finance factors shows that 55 (15%) lose significance under the corrected threshold. The corrected thresholds are a drop-in replacement for conventional critical values, requiring no change to how tests are designed or reported.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用最小贝叶斯因子（Minimum Bayes Factor）框架修正传统p值，建议将t检验的显著性阈值从±2（p≈0.05）提高到|t|≥2.5（p=0.015），以降低新研究的假阳性率。新阈值无需先验、不依赖停止规则，可直接替代传统临界值。对365个已发表金融因子的实证分析显示，55个（15%）因子在修正后失去显著性。
AI.research_question: 如何修正传统p值检验中因包含更极端结果概率而导致过度宽容的统计显著性阈值，以降低假阳性率？
AI.motivation: 传统p值是一个不等式，包含了比观测结果更极端结果的概率，使得显著性检验过于宽松，导致大量假阳性发现（如金融领域许多已发表因子可能不成立）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最小贝叶斯因子（Minimum Bayes Factor）框架：用点概率替代尾部概率，推导出修正的t统计量临界阈值。
AI.method: 基于最小贝叶斯因子框架推导新的临界t值；对365个已发表金融因子进行实证检验，对比新旧阈值下的显著性变化。
AI.findings: 传统的t≈±2（双尾p≈0.05）应替换为|t|≥2.5（p=0.015）；对365个金融因子的实证分析显示，55个（15%）因子在新阈值下失去显著性。该修正具有前瞻性，且无需先验、不依赖停止规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于最小贝叶斯因子的统计显著性修正方法，用点概率替代尾部概率，不需先验信息即可降低假阳性率，是对传统频率学派p值检验的理论改进。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接替代传统临界值的修正阈值（|t|≥2.5，p=0.015），无需改变研究设计和报告方式；实证表明该修正能有效筛选出大量可能虚假的金融因子，提升研究可重复性。

title: Identifying Compensable Disruptions in Long-Term Contracts: The Risk-Return Frontier Test

detail.title: Identifying Compensable Disruptions in Long-Term Contracts: The Risk-Return Frontier Test
detail.abstract: Investment disputes involving long-term contracts frequently turn on a simple question: is the loss the investor suffered a realization of risks it priced when it committed capital, or a disruption of the economic assumptions underlying the original bargain? Current arbitration practice answers this question through legal doctrine, fair and equitable treatment, legitimate expectations, economic equilibrium, without a systematic quantitative method for making the underlying economic determination. This article provides that method. The Risk-Return Frontier Test (RRFT) is a fourstep framework that reconstructs the ex-ante distribution of investment outcomes priced at the time of commitment and determines whether the adverse event at issue falls within that distribution (a non-compensable movement along the frontier) or shifts the distribution itself (a compensable frontier shift). The methodology combines discounted cash flow scenario analysis, simulation, and structural break testing into a unified, sequentially applied framework. A worked numerical example, a 25-year offshore hydrocarbon concession with a $4.65 billion development investment, calibrated to a 13.6% after-tax IRR at an 8% WACC demonstrates the application and produces an auditable, tribunal-ready quantification of the compensable loss. The framework is addressed to economic experts, arbitration counsel, and tribunals seeking a principled, evidence-based method for distinguishing compensable from non-compensable investment risk in long-term contracts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"风险-收益前沿检验"（RRFT）的四步框架，用于量化区分长期合同投资纠纷中可赔偿与不可赔偿的风险。该方法结合折现现金流情景分析、模拟和结构性断点检验，通过一个25年海上油气特许权的数值示例进行演示，为仲裁庭提供可审计的损失量化依据。
AI.research_question: 在长期合同投资纠纷中，如何系统性地量化区分投资者已定价的风险（不可赔偿）与颠覆原始交易经济假设的风险（可赔偿）？
AI.motivation: 当前仲裁实践依赖法律教义（如公平公正待遇、合法期待、经济均衡）来区分可赔偿与不可赔偿风险，缺乏系统性的量化经济判断方法，导致裁决缺乏一致性和可预测性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险-收益前沿理论：投资者的初始投资决策基于对投资结果分布的定价；如果不利事件落在该分布范围内（沿前沿移动），则风险已被定价、不可赔偿；如果事件改变了分布本身（前沿移动），则构成可赔偿损失。
AI.method: 四步RRFT框架：（1）折现现金流情景分析建模；（2）蒙特卡洛模拟生成投资结果的事前分布；（3）结构性断点检验识别事件是否改变了结果分布；（4）量化可赔偿损失。通过一个25年海上油气项目（投资46.5亿美元，税后IRR 13.6%，WACC 8%）进行数值验证。
AI.findings: RRFT框架能够产生可审计、可直接用于仲裁庭的损失量化结果，在区分已定价风险和系统性风险偏移方面优于当前纯法律教义的方法，为仲裁实践提供了原则性、基于证据的量化工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融学中的风险-收益前沿理论与法律仲裁中的可赔偿损失问题系统交叉结合，提出了一个跨学科的理论框架，弥合了法律教义与经济量化分析之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济专家、仲裁律师和仲裁庭提供了一个可直接操作的、可审计的、基于证据的四步量化方法，提高了投资仲裁的可预测性、一致性和科学性，特别适用于油气、基础设施等长期合同纠纷。

title: Consumer Segmentation and Non-Price Determinants of Meat Consumption in Urban South Africa: Implications for Climate-Resilient Food Systems
affiliations: University of the Witwatersrand, Florida Gulf Coast University and Pennsylvania State University - School of International Affairs

detail.title: Consumer Segmentation and Non-Price Determinants of Meat Consumption in Urban South Africa: Implications for Climate-Resilient Food Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Alice Beghin, Johane Dikgang, and Mare Sarr state that they have no conflicts of interest, financial or personal, that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was obtained in accordance with the South African research ethics guidelines for surveys involving human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the South African-Norwegian Research Cooperation Program (SANCOOP), which is jointly funded by the South African Department of Science and Innovation (DSI) and the Norwegian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA). The implementation was carried out by South Africa's National Research Foundation (NRF) and Norway's Research Council (RCN).

detail.abstract: Enhancing urban food system sustainability is challenging because one-size-fits-all policies often overlook significant differences in consumer behaviors. Using survey data from 434 households in Gauteng, South Africa, this study created and tested a consumer segmentation framework for urban meat consumption. Segments were categorized based on weekly intake thresholds aligned with the national dietary guidelines. Negative binomial regression models were estimated separately within each segment to identify the non-price factors influencing consumption. The results show that the high-intake segment, representing 25% of households, is responsible for approximately 52% of the meat-related water, land, and carbon footprints in the sample. Behavioral drivers vary: taste and cultural significance are the main factors for high-intake consumers, who are largely unaffected by environmental messages, whereas environmental awareness and health concerns most effectively reduce consumption among low-and moderateintake households. Based on published South African own-price elasticity estimates, we find that price-based measures are least effective where the environmental impact is greatest: the compensated own-price elasticity for beef among high-intake consumers is approximately-0.11. These findings support targeted demand-side policies, such as social norms and taste-focused strategies for high-intake groups and environmental labeling and health campaigns for the majority, rather than uniform price interventions. The framework provides a practical and replicable approach for designing targeted actions to promote sustainable food systems in middle-income urban settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于南非豪登省434户家庭数据，构建了城市肉类消费细分框架，发现高消费群体（25%家庭）贡献了约52%的肉类环境足迹，且价格手段对高消费群体效果最弱，提出应针对不同消费群体采取差异化的需求侧政策。
AI.research_question: 如何针对城市肉类消费中不同行为的消费者群体，制定差异化的可持续食品系统政策？
AI.motivation: 一刀切的政策常忽视消费者行为的显著差异，难以有效提升城市食品系统的可持续性，需要更精细化的消费者细分框架来指导政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者细分理论；行为经济学（非价格因素对消费行为的影响）；环境足迹核算（水、土地、碳足迹）；需求价格弹性理论。
AI.method: 基于434户家庭调查数据，依据国家膳食指南的周摄入量阈值进行消费者细分；采用负二项回归模型分别估计各细分群体中影响消费的非价格因素；结合已有自价格弹性估计值评估价格措施的效果。
AI.findings: 高消费群体（25%家庭）贡献约52%的肉类环境足迹；高消费群体的主要驱动力是口味和文化意义，几乎不受环境信息影响；低和中消费群体更容易受环境意识和健康关注影响而减少消费；高消费群体的牛肉补偿自价格弹性约为-0.11，价格措施对环境影响最大的群体效果最弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了可复制的城市肉类消费细分框架，揭示了不同消费群体对非价格因素（口味、文化、环境意识、健康关注）的差异化响应机制，并验证了价格弹性在不同群体中的异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中等收入城市环境下的可持续食品政策提供了具体建议：对高消费群体采用社会规范和口味导向策略，对多数消费者采用环境标签和健康宣传，而非统一的定价干预。
